description: DIBS implements hourly ISO 13790 building-energy simulation in Python for individual buildings and non-residential stocks. The repository links a German ENOB:dataNWG application and states that development moved to four installable package repositories in April 2024. Users should follow those links for the current package, not assume the legacy repository is current. Results depend on the building parameters and weather inputs. Published by IWUGERMANY (repository owner). Spatial and temporal resolution are source-dependent; any detail not stated above remains unknown. Access is through the provider documentation and software links; no software was installed. Reuse licence: MIT. The described release is free to access; licence restrictions still apply. Potential simulation uses include climate adaptation, optimisation. Related catalogue records: model-energyplus. These are contextual links, not a claim of a tested integration.
